newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese shares ended mixed, helped by PT.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese shares ended mixed, helped by PT.

text.p: Shares ended mixed helped by the positive performance of Portugal Telecom after the company announced it had chosen the Anglo-American venture Concert as its global ally in the telecommunications market.
*The share ended 0.49 percent higher at 6,130 escudos.

*Cimpor performed well, gaining 1.75 percent to 3,488 escudos but there was no particular explanation. Under normal circumstances, the stock could have been expected to weaken ahead of the admittance of some privatisation shares to trade on Wednesday.
*Elsewhere the market was depressed by the negative international tone and the foreign trend was expected to dictate the mood again on Tuesday.
*The PSI20 index closed 0.15 percent up at 6,060.80, with futures gaining by a similar amount.
*Portucel Industrial also closed down but should have some potential for gain given the improving international outlook for the pulp sector, traders said.
